chapters.title: Lesson 1: Completing the Whole
learningGoals: Understand what Vedic Maths is and why it improves confidence.
Use base-10 completion for faster mental arithmetic.
Solve near-ten addition and subtraction with clear steps.

chapters.title: Lesson 2: Doubling and Halving
subtopics: Balancing Trick - One Doubles, One Halves
learningGoals: Double and halve any number instantly without paper.
Use the balancing trick to make hard multiplications easy.
Apply *5, *25, /5, /25 shortcuts using doubling and halving.

exerciseFlow.subtopic: Balancing one number up and one down
Reverse tricks for divide by 5 and 25

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Multiplication by 11
learningGoals: Apply the insert-sum pattern for x11.
Generalize the method to larger numbers.

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Vertical and Crosswise (2-digit)
learningGoals: Manage carry propagation in each step.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: All from 9 and Last from 10
Chapter 6: Nikhilam (Near Base Multiplication)
learningGoals: Use deviations from base for multiplication.
Split and combine left-right parts correctly.
Solve near-base products faster than long multiplication.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Squares Ending in 5
learningGoals: Build speed with repeated pattern practice.

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Yavadunam (Deficiency Method)
learningGoals: Apply deficiency method for near-base products.
Choose correct digit width for right part.
Avoid sign and carry mistakes in mixed cases.

chapters.title: Chapter 9: General Multiplication Strategy
learningGoals: Choose an efficient strategy by number type.

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Quick Division by 9
learningGoals: Compute quotient and remainder for /9 fast.
Write answers in qRr format consistently.

chapters.title: Chapter 11: Vinculum Numbers (Intro)
learningGoals: Convert between standard and vinculum notation.
Use vinculum as an intermediate simplification tool.

chapters.title: Chapter 12: Fractions and Decimals
learningGoals: Estimate and verify decimal magnitude quickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Factorisation Basics
learningGoals: Map expanded and factor forms bidirectionally.

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Cubes Intro and Review
learningGoals: Review and connect all prior chapter methods.
